# Math Test: Inline and Display

Inline math: $f(x) = x^2$ and $\alpha + \beta = \gamma$.

Display math:

$$
E = mc^2
$$

Multi-line display:

$$
J(\theta)
=
\frac{1}{m}
\sum_{i=1}^{m}
(h_\theta(x_i) - y_i)^2
$$

Backslash inline: \(x^2 + y^2\)

Backslash display:

\[
\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}(x_i-y_i)^2
\]
